notes.title: Localizations for 11 languages
notes.content:
- Added a localization for 11 languages (english, spanish, french, german, indonesian, turkish, polish, ukrainian, italian, portuguese, russian)
- Improved fast-scrolling through Universe (for fast-scrolling just hold right thumbstick up or down).

notes.title: Solar System
notes.content:
- You can compare the sizes of the planets relative to each other and relative to the sun. 
- You will see how strikingly different the orbits of the planets are, their speed of rotation around the sun and around their own axis
- Compare how different the length of the year is on different planets compared to Earth, etc.
